title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling samples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: Provide first-party RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to accelerate onboarding for app developers and platform teams. This change bundles: 1) three opinionated RAG templates (faq-bot, doc-assistant, codebase-search) with ready-to-run configs for Redwood Hosted and Dedicated; 2) two agent tool-calling examples (search+browser, db-query tool) that demonstrate function signatures and structured responses; 3) docs site pages and quickstart snippets with screenshots and curl/SDK examples. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and sample datasets - [x] Add TS and Python example runtimes for agent tool-calling - [x] Docs site pages + redirects - [x] Integration tests for quickstart up-to-first-response - [x] Run spellcheck and lint - [x] Update CHANGELOG and release notes Notes: Templates are intentionally small and opinionated; advanced tuning (multi-index, hybrid search) will be covered in follow-ups (ENG-5023). The description below includes usage notes and required env vars. For Dedicated/private deployments, the quickstarts include an optional config section for pinning model variants and KV cache settings. Related: PRs pr-43278 (minor docs fixes) and pr-43156 (agent templates upstream); Linear ENG-4981 tracks follow-ups for eval harnesses and additional datasets. Testing: run examples/redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag/* integration script (scripts/run_quickstart.sh) which brings up a local dev server, ingests the provided sample corpus, and runs an end-to-end request asserting structured tool responses. Merge strategy: squash-merge to keep history focused.
commits: feat: add faq-bot, doc-assistant, and codebase-search RAG templates
feat: add agent tool-calling sample: search+browser example (TS + PY)
docs: add quickstart pages and navigation entries to docs site

chore: fix lint warnings and update example README

1) cd redwood-examples && ./scripts/run_quickstart.sh --example faq-bot --short-corpus
2) follow README steps for TS or PY agent to run a sample query and verify the structured tool response
3) run pytest redwood-examples/tests/integration/test_rag_quickstart.py to validate CI-like flow
